detail.description: a stub Baseline A is credited as decision value
detail.detail: AnalysisDefect: Baseline A for walmart carries no risks. `top_risks` and `risk_severity` are two of the seven material fields and both are computed from them, so an A with none concedes them before the comparison starts.

detail.description: prose is counted as a decision delta
detail.detail: AssertionError: a wording-only difference registered as a material decision delta; every rephrasing would count as product value

detail.description: a material field moves with no world-model fact behind it
detail.detail: AssertionError: a material decision delta carries no trigger, mechanism or provenance; §13 refuses to credit it and the run would have reported it as value

detail.description: B adds macro risks without changing the decision
detail.detail: AssertionError: every driver now becomes a risk regardless of direction or magnitude; B would inject macro commentary into every company analysis and DecisionDamage IRRELEVANT_MACRO is what catches it

detail.description: a bleed is emitted as a proven cause
detail.detail: WorldModelDefect: a causal bleed carries status 'PROVEN_CAUSE'. A bleed is a measured non-response with a CANDIDATE explanation. Rates fell, demand did not respond, therefore fear -- is a story, and the whole point of the object is that it stays one until something tests it.

detail.description: a relation is judged before its lag has elapsed
detail.detail: WorldModelDefect: r was scored CONTRADICTED with 10 of 180 lag days elapsed. A mechanism that has not had time to fire has not failed to fire.

detail.description: rehearsal resolutions count toward the real ladder
detail.detail: AssertionError: the rehearsal ledger now writes into the real forward file; 36 resolved rehearsal predictions with constant probabilities would move the real calibration ladder to EARLY_CALIBRATION

detail.description: an open forward expectation is edited
detail.detail: LedgerViolation: the ledger accepted a changed horizon on an existing expectation; the forward record is editable

detail.description: a frozen human-state series becomes a company driver
detail.detail: AssertionError: ['UMCSENT'] appear as company drivers while CollectiveHumanState is FROZEN_CANDIDATE with zero promoted constructs

detail.description: the visibility check leaves the state builder
detail.detail: AssertionError: EconomicState.build no longer checks node visibility; a tenant-private observation could enter the shared public state

detail.description: the lineage walk stops finding ancestors
detail.detail: AssertionError: a corroborator two hops up the lineage was not found

detail.description: the no-change branch of the stagnation detector goes
detail.detail: AssertionError: no company analysis changed and the detector reported STABLE; a cycle where nothing moves would be recorded as healthy learning

detail.description: the identical-state branch of the detector goes
detail.detail: AssertionError: a state compared with itself produced no alert; the exact call-site bug the detector caught last run would now pass silently

detail.description: Baseline A is emptied of its structural knowledge
detail.detail: AnalysisDefect: Baseline A for walmart carries no risks. `top_risks` and `risk_severity` are two of the seven material fields and both are computed from them, so an A with none concedes them before the comparison starts.

detail.description: A and B are given different evidence cutoffs
detail.detail: AssertionError: A dated 2026-01-01 was compared against B dated 2026-06-01; the treatment becomes 'more recent data' rather than 'the world model'

detail.description: the scenario type collapses into the causal one
detail.detail: AssertionError: the counterfactual type wall no longer separates a scenario assumption from a causal estimate; a History Rewind what-if would render with the standing of a measured effect

meta_guard: every proof declared a mutated symbol distinct from the guard it tests, and a production call path that was checked to contain the call. Proofs marked guard_integrity are counted separately and are NOT defect coverage.
